name: NA Multi-Contact Escalation Insights - BigQuery + Level AI v1

parameters.formDescription: Escalation mix, journey breakdown, customer asks and agent resolutions for the NA Multi-Contact / CARE queues. Leave the numeric fields blank for the defaults (90-day window, 8 transcripts per journey, 120 max).

nodes.name: Escalation Insight Request
nodes.notes: Run on demand. To schedule, replace with a Schedule Trigger + Set node supplying the same field names.

parameters.jsCode:
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Build Escalation SQL
// Emits two queries: the quantitative escalation detail set, and the
// journey-stratified transcript sample. Literals are inlined (the n8n
// BigQuery node does not pass query parameters).
// Mirrors sql/10_escalation_detail.sql and sql/20_escalation_transcript_sample.sql
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const cfg = $input.first().json.config;
const T = cfg.tables;

const s = (v) => "'" + String(v).replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/'/g, "\\'") + "'";
const arr = (a) => '[' + a.map(s).join(', ') + ']';
const n = (v) => String(Math.round(Number(v)));

const rosterArr = arr(cfg.rosterTeamPatterns);
const escArr = arr(cfg.escalationDetailPatterns);
const queueArr = arr(cfg.queuePatterns);

const regionGuard = cfg.naRegionOnly
  ? `AND (employee_working_region IS NULL
         OR LOWER(employee_working_region) LIKE '%north america%'
         OR LOWER(employee_working_region) IN ('na','us','usa','canada'))`
  : '';

const rosterCte = `
latest_employee AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn) FROM (
    SELECT
      e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.employee_email, e.employee_manager_name,
      e.employee_workgroup_name, e.employee_working_region, e.employee_working_team,
      e.employee_working_site, e.employee_date,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM \`${T.employee}\` e
    WHERE e.employee_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
      AND e.employee_is_in_customer_service_org_flag
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
mc_roster AS (
  SELECT * FROM latest_employee
  WHERE (
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(${rosterArr}) p
              WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(employee_working_team, '')) LIKE p)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(${rosterArr}) p
              WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(employee_workgroup_name, '')) LIKE p)
  )
  ${regionGuard}
)`;

const escCte = `
esc_wraps AS (
  SELECT
    w.wrap_id,
    CAST(w.customer_contact_id AS STRING) AS contact_id,
    w.customer_order_id,
    w.wrap_agent_id,
    w.wrap_datetime,
    DATE(w.wrap_datetime) AS wrap_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(w.wrap_datetime), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS wrap_week,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(w.wrap_datetime), MONTH) AS wrap_month,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.wrap_primary_reason), ''), 'Unclassified') AS journey,
    w.wrap_reason_detail AS escalation_detail_reason,
    w.wrap_contact_channel,
    w.is_customer_issue_resolved,
    w.is_automated_wrap,
    w.wrap_contacted_by_agent_id AS escalated_by_agent_id
  FROM \`${T.wrap}\` w
  -- If wrap_datetime is DATETIME rather than TIMESTAMP, swap the next line for:
  --   WHERE w.wrap_datetime >= DATETIME_SUB(CURRENT_DATETIME(), INTERVAL n DAY)
  WHERE w.wrap_datetime >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL ${n(cfg.lookbackDays)} DAY)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(${escArr}) p
                WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(w.wrap_reason_detail, '')) LIKE p)
)`;

const laiCte = `
lai AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn) FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(l.ContactID AS STRING) AS contact_id,
      l.OrderNumber AS lai_order_number,
      l.banking_conversation_id,
      CAST(l.asr_log_id AS STRING) AS asr_log_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(l.ContactID AS STRING)
                         ORDER BY l.ContactDateTime DESC) AS rn
    FROM \`${T.laiPipeline}\` l
    WHERE DATE(l.ContactDateTime) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL ${n(cfg.lookbackDays + 2)} DAY)
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)`;

// ---- Query 1: escalation detail -------------------------------------------
const detailQuery = `
-- NA MC/CARE escalation detail | ${cfg.reportPeriodLabel} | ${cfg.requestId}
WITH ${rosterCte},
${escCte},
queue_ctx AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn) FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(wc.wrap_compliance_contact_id AS STRING) AS contact_id,
      wc.wrap_compliance_contact_queue_name AS queue_name,
      wc.wrap_compliance_entry_type AS entry_type,
      wc.wrap_compliance_event_datetime AS contact_datetime,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(wc.wrap_compliance_contact_id AS STRING)
                         ORDER BY wc.wrap_compliance_event_datetime DESC) AS rn
    FROM \`${T.datamart}\` t, UNNEST(t.wrap_compliance) AS wc
    WHERE t.employee_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL ${n(cfg.lookbackDays + 2)} DAY)
      AND wc.wrap_compliance_contact_id IS NOT NULL
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
${laiCte}
SELECT
  e.wrap_id,
  e.contact_id,
  e.customer_order_id AS order_id,
  CAST(e.wrap_datetime AS STRING) AS wrap_datetime,
  CAST(e.wrap_date AS STRING) AS wrap_date,
  CAST(e.wrap_week AS STRING) AS wrap_week,
  CAST(e.wrap_month AS STRING) AS wrap_month,
  e.journey,
  e.escalation_detail_reason,
  e.wrap_contact_channel,
  e.is_customer_issue_resolved,
  e.is_automated_wrap,
  r.employee_id AS mc_agent_id,
  r.employee_name AS mc_agent_name,
  r.employee_email AS mc_agent_email,
  r.employee_manager_name AS mc_manager_name,
  r.employee_working_team AS mc_team,
  r.employee_working_site AS mc_site,
  q.queue_name,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(q.queue_name,'')) LIKE '%care%'  THEN 'CARE'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(q.queue_name,'')) LIKE '%multi%' THEN 'Multi-Contact'
    ELSE 'Other / Unmapped'
  END AS queue_group,
  COALESCE(CAST(e.customer_order_id AS STRING), l.lai_order_number) AS order_number_final,
  l.banking_conversation_id AS levelai_conversation_id,
  l.asr_log_id,
  CASE WHEN l.banking_conversation_id IS NOT NULL
       THEN CONCAT(${s(cfg.levelAiUrlPrefix)}, CAST(l.banking_conversation_id AS STRING)) END AS levelai_url,
  (l.asr_log_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_transcript_handle
FROM esc_wraps e
JOIN mc_roster r ON r.employee_id = e.wrap_agent_id
LEFT JOIN queue_ctx q ON q.contact_id = e.contact_id
LEFT JOIN lai l ON l.contact_id = e.contact_id
WHERE q.queue_name IS NULL
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(${queueArr}) p WHERE LOWER(q.queue_name) LIKE p)
ORDER BY e.wrap_datetime DESC
LIMIT ${n(cfg.maxDetailRows)}
`.trim();

// ---- Query 2: journey-stratified transcript sample ------------------------
const sampleQuery = `
-- NA MC/CARE escalation transcript sample | ${cfg.reportPeriodLabel} | ${cfg.requestId}
WITH ${rosterCte},
${escCte},
${laiCte},
eligible AS (
  SELECT
    e.wrap_id, e.contact_id, e.journey, e.escalation_detail_reason,
    e.wrap_datetime, e.is_customer_issue_resolved,
    r.employee_name AS mc_agent_name,
    COALESCE(CAST(e.customer_order_id AS STRING), l.lai_order_number) AS order_number,
    l.asr_log_id, l.banking_conversation_id
  FROM esc_wraps e
  JOIN mc_roster r ON r.employee_id = e.wrap_agent_id
  JOIN lai l ON l.contact_id = e.contact_id
  WHERE l.asr_log_id IS NOT NULL
),
sampled AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn_journey) FROM (
    SELECT eligible.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journey ORDER BY RAND()) AS rn_journey
    FROM eligible
  ) WHERE rn_journey <= ${n(cfg.perJourneySample)}
),
transcripts AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(u.asr_log_id AS STRING) AS asr_log_id,
    COUNT(*) AS utterance_count,
    STRING_AGG(CONCAT(COALESCE(u.speaker,'UNKNOWN'), ': ', u.transcript), '\\n'
               ORDER BY u.start_time) AS transcript_text
  FROM \`${T.utterances}\` u
  WHERE u.transcript IS NOT NULL
    AND LENGTH(u.transcript) > 0
    AND CAST(u.asr_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT asr_log_id FROM sampled)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  s.contact_id, s.wrap_id, s.journey, s.escalation_detail_reason,
  CAST(s.wrap_datetime AS STRING) AS wrap_datetime,
  s.is_customer_issue_resolved, s.mc_agent_name, s.order_number, s.asr_log_id,
  s.banking_conversation_id AS levelai_conversation_id,
  CASE WHEN s.banking_conversation_id IS NOT NULL
       THEN CONCAT(${s(cfg.levelAiUrlPrefix)}, CAST(s.banking_conversation_id AS STRING)) END AS levelai_url,
  t.utterance_count,
  LENGTH(t.transcript_text) > ${n(cfg.maxTranscriptChars)} AS transcript_truncated,
  SUBSTR(t.transcript_text, 1, ${n(cfg.maxTranscriptChars)}) AS transcript_text
FROM sampled s
JOIN transcripts t USING (asr_log_id)
WHERE t.utterance_count >= ${n(cfg.minUtterances)}
ORDER BY s.journey, s.wrap_datetime DESC
LIMIT ${n(cfg.maxTotalSample)}
`.trim();

return [{ json: { config: cfg, detailQuery, sampleQuery } }];
